hook: You pay sixty-five dollars a year for a fantasy app. Then you find out this one does it all... for free.
finder: You want a trade. So, it searches every roster in your league, and finds deals the other guy actually says yes to.
startsit: You're stuck on a coin flip. So, it breaks the tie with real numbers. Start Cook. Sit Henry. Decided.
redzone: Sunday hits. It shows you every game live, and exactly which of your players are on the field, right now.
odds: Then, it plays your season ten thousand times... and tells you your playoff odds, every single week.
weather: Wind, rain and cold are baked into every projection. One tap, and your best lineup is set.
waivers: Waiver night. It shows you who everyone's adding, and who's a trap.
recap: And when the week's over, it makes a forty-five second recap video, right on your phone. Send it to the group chat.
cta: War Room. Any ESPN or Sleeper league. Free. Well... obviously.
